name: Catchuparr
description: Local rolling catch-up archive and start-over for Dispatcharr
author: nilleiz

fields.label: Channel UUIDs (one per line)
fields.help_text: Only selected channels are recorded. Without a source override, recording uses the shared live stream.

fields.label: Live source rules
fields.help_text: Rules apply only to M3U sources already assigned to a channel. Leave blank to share the live stream. Use *, number, name, or group selectors with include-only, exclude-only, priority, or unchanged mode. Validate previews; Apply activates atomically. Overrides use a dedicated worker and may need another provider slot.

fields.label: Archive path
fields.help_text: A local filesystem shared by web and Celery workers.

fields.label: User ID for new M3U token
fields.help_text: Set the Dispatcharr user ID before creating an access token.
